messages.message: Load a foreground spectrum (with fitted peaks) to fit the detector's FWHM here.

Optional baseline efficiency uncertainty: a fractional (e.g. 0.05 = 5%) 1-sigma uncertainty that applies, and is fully correlated, within each energy band, and is uncorrelated between bands. The Activity/Shielding fit can fold this into its results. (A Monte-Carlo-characterized response provides its own, finer, energy-correlated uncertainty; these bands add to it.)
Tip: after choosing "Use", you can download this detector as an XML file or a QR code (buttons on the Detector Select dialog), or find it again later under the "Previous" tab of Detector Select.
